title: Jawa Edition Title
description: this resource pack change title from "Java Edition" to "Jawa Edition"
body:
# Jawa Edition Title
this mod will change the "Java Edition" title to the "Jawa Edition"

Why did I create this resource pack? Because the Java programming language name actually comes from “Kopi Jawa” (Javanese coffee), and the word "Java" can be translated as “Jawa” in Indonesian.

My friends also call it “Minecraft Jawa”; I know they're just joking, but I decided to create this resource pack anyway.
